item.title: Hackathon Challenge: automate the one task you keep putting off
item.description: Pick the recurring chore you never quite get to and hand it to an agent. It is harder, and more interesting, than a cron job. There is also $40K in it.

item.title: ToolSimulator: scalable tool testing for AI agents
item.description: ToolSimulator is an LLM-powered framework within Strands Evals that enables safe, scalable agent testing by using simulated tool responses instead of risky live API calls.
